notes: Default resident cap: 5. Bundled overfull locations redistributed to suitable meeting points. Existing user moves are respected by the one-time relocation migration. Prune remains at Mondstadt Fountain Plaza. Travelling companions do not consume resident slots.

characters.name: Aether
characters.rationale: Aether's card opens on this beach, at the moment the game does. Only the Traveler is found here: the other twin has the Abyss role and is found in the Chasm, and a twin the player plays is never a resident.

characters.name: Arataki Itto
characters.rationale: Itto is explicitly famed in Hanamizaka, and the bulletin board there contains his messages and his repeated challenges to Sara. A public Hanamizaka waypoint is more defensible than inventing a home for him.

characters.name: Beidou
characters.rationale: The Crux is Beidou's fleet and the Alcor is its flagship, anchored at Guyun Stone Forest. It is her strongest canonical base.

characters.name: Chevreuse
characters.rationale: Chevreuse has no confirmed residence. Palais Mermonia is an existing waypoint in Fontaine's administrative center, suitable for a work-related roleplay meeting with the captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol. Treat this as a practical encounter point, not her home.

characters.name: Clorinde
characters.rationale: Clorinde duels at the Opera Epiclese and guarded Furina for years; the fountain outside the Opera keeps the two together. Her greeting now opens there.

characters.name: Dori
characters.rationale: The Palace is Dori's official residence, designed by Kaveh and owned by her. It is the strongest exact home assignment in this batch.

characters.name: Escoffier
characters.rationale: Hotel Debord is Escoffier's former kitchen and the recurring setting of her story quest. A newer source says she currently runs another restaurant in Fleuve Cendre, but does not identify its exact address; Hotel Debord is the best named, established map destination.

characters.name: Fischl
characters.rationale: Fischl investigates for the Guild; her greeting already asked about the city gate, which stands on the Cider Lake bridge. Katheryne stays at the Guild counter.

characters.name: Ganyu
characters.rationale: Official character profile identifies Ganyu as Yuehai Pavilion secretary and says she returns there each day; her work is on Yujing Terrace. Assign the office waypoint rather than the Jade Chamber.

characters.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
characters.rationale: Beidou took Kazuha aboard the Alcor as a temporary crewmember when he needed to escape Inazuma. He later sails with the Crux; assign him to the proposed Alcor waypoint with Beidou.

characters.name: Kujou Sara
characters.rationale: Sara is the general and leader of the Tenryou Commission's forces, responsible for security in Inazuma City. The commission headquarters is a stronger match than Tenshukaku, where she is only a visitor to the Shogun.

characters.name: Layla
characters.rationale: An Akademiya astronomy student at the Akademiya’s rainforest research site, where the sky is clearer. A roleplay meeting point, not a home. Her greeting now opens there.

characters.name: Lumine
characters.rationale: Lumine's card opens on this beach, at the moment the game does. Only the Traveler is found here: the other twin has the Abyss role and is found in the Chasm, and a twin the player plays is never a resident.

characters.name: Mika
characters.rationale: A Reconnaissance Company surveyor fits the newly mapped village of Millhaven on Windrest Peak. A roleplay meeting point on his survey route, not a home. His greeting now opens there.

characters.name: Noelle
characters.rationale: Noelle runs errands for anyone in Mondstadt who needs help; Springvale gives her chores to do outside the city. A roleplay meeting point, not a home. Her greeting now opens there.

characters.name: Rosaria
characters.rationale: Rosaria skips her Cathedral duties and spends evenings at The Cat’s Tail, which is where her card greeting already opens.

characters.name: Sethos
characters.rationale: Sethos is from the Temple of Silence and became its leader. This is his clearest organizational home, although it is a story-unlocked instance rather than an everyday city residence.

characters.name: Skirk
characters.rationale: Skirk is a wanderer with no fixed Teyvat home. Her current story quest has her encounter the Traveler at Wanmin Restaurant, an existing Liyue waypoint. Mark this as a canon meeting point for roleplay, not her residence.

characters.name: Varka
characters.rationale: The Knights’ Dornman Port base gives their Grand Master an appropriate command meeting point without crowding headquarters.

characters.name: Vodyanitsa
characters.rationale: Vodyanitsa performs with a Snezhnograd troupe, and her greeting already opens backstage in a theatre.

characters.name: Xingqiu
characters.rationale: Xingqiu is the second son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild; his story quest has the Traveler visit his residence in Liyue Harbor. Use the outdoor guild-residence waypoint rather than pretending the instance interior has map coordinates.

characters.name: Yaoyao
characters.rationale: Yaoyao runs errands among the adepti, and Xianyun’s waterfront meeting point matches her greeting by the Liyue Harbor docks.

characters.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
characters.rationale: Mizuki is the bathhouse's major shareholder and personally treats guests there. Aisa Bathhouse is her strongest canon work/home base.

characters.name: Aloy
characters.rationale: Wolvendom is a suitable forest trail for a roaming hunter. This is a roleplay encounter point, not a canonical home.

characters.name: Arlecchino
characters.rationale: The Hotel Bouffes d’ete is the House of the Hearth’s Fontaine base and is associated with Arlecchino. This is her strongest known current home/work location.

characters.name: Bennett
characters.rationale: Bennett is a Mondstadt Adventurers’ Guild member and leads Benny’s Adventure Team. The Guild is his best encounter/start point, not a claim about his private residence.

characters.name: Chongyun
characters.rationale: Chongyun’s card greeting already opens at Wangshu Inn, where he investigates reports of spirits on the road.

characters.name: Cyno
characters.rationale: Cyno was raised by the priests of the Temple of Silence. His greeting now opens there.

characters.name: Durin
characters.rationale: A library visit already matches Durin’s main card greeting and interest in stories.

characters.name: Eula
characters.rationale: An off-duty meeting at Angel’s Share fits Eula’s established tavern visits.

characters.name: Freminet
characters.rationale: Freminet is a member of the House of the Hearth and the hotel is its Fontaine base. Tie him here as a current home base.

characters.name: Iansan
characters.rationale: Iansan is from and represents the Collective of Plenty; the tribe’s settlement is the most direct home location.

characters.name: Keqing
characters.rationale: Keqing’s Yuheng duties place her at Yujing Terrace, the Qixing’s administrative terrace. This is a work base rather than a claim about her home.

characters.name: Kuki Shinobu
characters.rationale: Kuki has no confirmed residence or gang headquarters address. She is the Arataki Gang’s deputy, and her profile and Hangout quest tie her public appearances and community work to Hanamizaka. This is a clearly roleplay-oriented shared meeting point in that neighborhood, not a claim that she works or lives at the Bantan Sango Detective Agency.

characters.name: Linnea
characters.rationale: Linnea advises the Nasha Town Adventurers’ Guild, and her greeting already opens beside it.

characters.name: Mona
characters.rationale: Mona lives in the laboratory/house rented to her by Goth at the southern end of Mondstadt City. The waypoint is her actual residence.

characters.name: Ororon
characters.rationale: Ororon is a member of the Masters of the Night-Wind and is shown with a small home/farmstead in Natlan, but the exact present-day farmhouse coordinate is not published. Use the tribe’s settlement approach as a clearly marked roleplay meeting point, not as his exact house or confirmed residence.

characters.name: Sandrone
characters.rationale: After the Nod-Krai battle, Sandrone’s core is returned to the Fontaine Research Institute and she reawakens there; this is her best current story-linked meeting point. The game does not establish that it is her permanent residence.

characters.name: Shenhe
characters.rationale: Shenhe grew up as Cloud Retainer’s disciple on Mt. Aocang. Her greeting now opens there.

characters.name: Sucrose
characters.rationale: Albedo’s assistant can share his research camp. This is a roleplay research meeting point, not a claim of permanent residence.

characters.name: Venti
characters.rationale: Venti has no stable home and wanders Mondstadt; Angel’s Share is a familiar public hangout and repeatable encounter point, not his residence.

characters.name: Wanderer
characters.rationale: The Wanderer stays near Nahida, and his card greeting already opens on a terrace above Sumeru City.

characters.name: Xinyan
characters.rationale: Xinyan is a travelling performer with no fixed home; the busy Yilong Wharf gives her an audience. Her greeting now opens there.

characters.name: Yelan
characters.rationale: Yelan took over Yanshang Teahouse after the former owner was imprisoned and uses it as her secret base. This is her strongest established base.

characters.name: Yun Jin
characters.rationale: Yun Jin performs at Heyu Tea House, and the World Quest “On the Stage, Behind the Stage” explicitly brings her there. This is her performance/meeting venue, not a claimed home.

characters.name: Amber
characters.rationale: Mondstadt Fountain Plaza is a public meeting point on the Outrider’s city patrol. This is not a private residence.

characters.name: Barbara
characters.rationale: Barbara serves as a deaconess at the Favonius Cathedral, so the cathedral is her strongest established day-to-day location. This is her workplace and public meeting point, not a private-home claim.

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.rationale: Charlotte is a reporter for The Steambird. Its office is a strong established work and meeting location, rather than a claim about her home.

characters.name: Citlali
characters.rationale: Citlali's Home is an explicitly named, in-game residence in the Masters of the Night-Wind territory, making this an exact canon-home assignment.

characters.name: Dahlia
characters.rationale: Dahlia is a deacon of the Church of Favonius. The cathedral is his established workplace and a sensible public meeting point, not a claimed residence.

characters.name: Emilie
characters.rationale: HoYoWiki identifies Emilie's perfume shop as being in the Vasari Passage. This is the best documented workplace/meeting point; the exact shop entrance is not a surveyed map marker, so the waypoint is an approximate point in the passage rather than a claimed private residence.

characters.name: Faruzan
characters.rationale: Faruzan is a Haravatat scholar and is associated with the Akademiya's House of Daena. This is a study/work meeting point, not a claim about her private residence.

characters.name: Gaming
characters.rationale: Gaming's father Yip Tak runs a tea business in Qiaoying Village, and Gaming's voice-over establishes that he lives with his father there. Qiaoying is therefore the supported home location.

characters.name: Illuga
characters.rationale: Illuga is a Lightkeeper associated with the Lightkeeper fortress at Piramida. The fortress is his established work base, not a claim about a separate private home.

characters.name: Kirara
characters.rationale: Kirara is a courier for Komaniya Express and has no confirmed fixed residence in the researched profile. Inazuma City is an explicit roleplay meeting default for her courier work, not a claim that she is always there or lives there.

characters.name: Lan Yan
characters.rationale: Lan Yan is from Qiaoying Village and returns to Chenyu Vale. Her exact private home is not identified, so Qiaoying Village is a hometown meeting default rather than a specific house claim.

characters.name: Lohen
characters.rationale: Lohen is stationed at the Knights of Favonius Base in Dornman Port. This is a confirmed duty station and work base, not a claimed residence.

characters.name: Nicole
characters.rationale: Nicole's greeting opens in the Witch's Garden, where her lodge is located.

characters.name: Razor
characters.rationale: Razor was raised by the wolves of Wolvendom and treats the forest as home, so Wolvendom is a clear canon home region and meeting place.

characters.name: Sayu
characters.rationale: Sayu carries messages for the Shuumatsuban and naps wherever the shade is good; the Inazuma City courier meeting point suits a hand-over. Her greeting now opens there.

characters.name: Shikanoin Heizou
characters.rationale: HoYoWiki describes Heizou as a detective from the Tenryou Commission, his actual employer. Use the same Tenryou Commission Headquarters waypoint as Kujou Sara; Bantan Sango is an independent detective agency and a rival workplace, not Heizou’s base.

characters.name: Varesa
characters.rationale: Varesa's family's orchard is the strongest lore tie, but the available orchard screenshot has a prominent button-shaped HUD glyph at the right edge. Use the clean, low path approach into the nearby Collective of Plenty as an honest roleplay meeting point; it is a settlement approach, not a depiction of her orchard.

characters.name: Vesna
characters.rationale: Vesna is identified as a Druzhna commander, so Druzhna HQ in Snezhnograd is her most defensible work base. This is not a claim that the HQ is her private home.

characters.name: Xianyun
characters.rationale: HoYoverse introduced Xianyun as a new resident of Liyue Harbor, and her story explains that she takes up residence there to understand what draws her disciples to the city. Use a Liyue Harbor meeting point rather than Mt. Aocang; no specific home address is established by these sources.

characters.name: Yanfei
characters.rationale: Yanfei advises Liyue’s merchants and the Qixing on contracts; the Jade Chamber is a meeting point on that work, not her office. Her greeting now opens there.

characters.name: Yoimiya
characters.rationale: Yoimiya runs Naganohara Fireworks with her family. The shop in Hanamizaka is her established work base and a strong natural home-meeting point, without claiming that the shop itself is her private residence.

characters.name: Zibai
characters.rationale: Zibai’s anecdote places her near Qiaoying Village; Jademouth, upriver in the same vale, suits her painting and adeptal memory. Her greeting now opens there.

characters.name: Prune
characters.rationale: Prune's card describes her as a Nod-Krai witch hunter visiting Mondstadt, and its existing greetings begin at the Mondstadt fountain. AZA identifies Nod-Krai as her point of departure and Mondstadt as her region; HoYoverse's May 2026 character introduction presents her as a self-styled Witch Hunter, while the official Mondstadt character page includes her among Mondstadt's characters. The fountain is therefore a fitting roleplay meeting default consistent with the card's greetings, not a claim that the game establishes it as her home.

relocations.rationale: Xinyan is a travelling performer with no fixed home; the busy Yilong Wharf gives her an audience. Her greeting now opens there.

relocations.name: Yaoyao
relocations.rationale: Yaoyao runs errands among the adepti, and Xianyun’s waterfront meeting point matches her greeting by the Liyue Harbor docks.

relocations.name: Yanfei
relocations.rationale: Yanfei advises Liyue’s merchants and the Qixing on contracts; the Jade Chamber is a meeting point on that work, not her office. Her greeting now opens there.

relocations.name: Zibai
relocations.rationale: Zibai’s anecdote places her near Qiaoying Village; Jademouth, upriver in the same vale, suits her painting and adeptal memory. Her greeting now opens there.

relocations.name: Thoma
relocations.rationale: Thoma first meets the Traveler at Ritou, where he handles the Kamisato household’s dealings with foreign ships. His greeting now opens there.

relocations.name: Sayu
relocations.rationale: Sayu carries messages for the Shuumatsuban and naps wherever the shade is good; the Inazuma City courier meeting point suits a hand-over. Her greeting now opens there.

relocations.name: Wanderer
relocations.rationale: The Wanderer stays near Nahida, and his card greeting already opens on a terrace above Sumeru City.

relocations.name: Kaveh
relocations.rationale: Kaveh designed the Palace of Alcazarzaray. His greeting now opens there.

relocations.name: Layla
relocations.rationale: An Akademiya astronomy student at the Akademiya’s rainforest research site, where the sky is clearer. A roleplay meeting point, not a home. Her greeting now opens there.

relocations.name: Cyno
relocations.rationale: Cyno was raised by the priests of the Temple of Silence. His greeting now opens there.

relocations.name: Furina
relocations.rationale: Furina’s story is bound to the Fountain of Lucine, in front of the Opera Epiclese. Her greeting now opens there.

relocations.name: Clorinde
relocations.rationale: Clorinde duels at the Opera Epiclese and guarded Furina for years; the fountain outside the Opera keeps the two together. Her greeting now opens there.

relocations.name: Linnea
relocations.rationale: Linnea advises the Nasha Town Adventurers’ Guild, and her greeting already opens beside it.

relocations.name: Vodyanitsa
relocations.rationale: Vodyanitsa performs with a Snezhnograd troupe, and her greeting already opens backstage in a theatre.

relocations.name: Tartaglia
relocations.rationale: A Harbinger answers to the Tsaritsa and is seldom home; his family stays in Morepesok. His greeting now opens at the palace.

relocations.name: Diluc
relocations.rationale: Diluc owns the Dawn Winery and lives there; his greeting now opens in its study. Angel’s Share keeps Venti and Eula.

relocations.name: Nicole
relocations.rationale: Her greeting opens in the Witch’s Garden. Preserve custom placements.
